```
WITH 
  success AS (
    SELECT 
      DATE_TRUNC('day', t.block_timestamp) AS day,
      COUNT(*) AS success_count
    FROM 
      `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.transaction_facts` t
    WHERE 
      t.block_timestamp >= DATE '2026-06-15' AND t.block_timestamp < DATE '2026-06-22'
    GROUP BY 
      DATE_TRUNC('day', t.block_timestamp)
  ),
  failure AS (
    SELECT 
      DATE_TRUNC('day', t.block_timestamp) AS day,
      COUNT(*) AS failure_count
    FROM 
      `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.transaction_facts` t
    WHERE 
      t.block_timestamp >= DATE '2026-06-15' AND t.block_timestamp < DATE '2026-06-22'
    AND t.is_success = FALSE
    GROUP BY 
      DATE_TRUNC('day', t.block_timestamp)
  )
SELECT 
  s.day, 
  s.success_count, 
  f.failure_count
FROM 
  success s
  JOIN 
  failure f
  ON 
  s.day = f.day
```
